svg.title: Three reusable GDPO design patterns
svg.desc: Four vertically stacked panels show the prescription-component pattern, criterion-method relevance, criterion-subject assessment pattern, and a notation key. Rectangular nodes denote classes or class expressions. Rounded nodes denote named individuals. Solid arrows denote asserted relations, OWL restrictions, or subclass axioms. Dotted arrows denote inferences. In the third panel, individual A1 is one assessment component that jointly identifies individual H1, an honesty statement, and individual U1, SK4 user-manual content. Its parent individual E2 is inferred to instantiate the communicative-honesty evaluation class.
